title: Verified review history and filters
guidance: Improve the review/filter header and author/date/rating/body/linked-job hierarchy. Keep verification concise at the upper right. Remove What verified means entirely.

Latest human direction: rebalance history heading/filter scale and spacing. Audit public Job buttons against actual access and requirements; do not send public readers to inevitably private job details. Record the contract decision. Keep long-review disclosure.

Latest human correction: make compact arrow paging hover more noticeable. Use a soft tonal circular fill plus a fine inset edge on enabled Previous/Next. This icon-navigation exception does not change quiet text-button hover.

decisions.title: A compact history header
decisions.reason: Verified reviews and the accessible rating select share a row where space permits. Native committed selection applies immediately; redundant Apply filter is removed.

decisions.title: Stable context beside readable history
decisions.reason: Profile and Ratings form an independent stack; long reviews cannot stretch their gap. Author/date sit left, verification upper-right, then stars, comment and linked job.

decisions.title: Remove redundant explanation
decisions.reason: What verified means is removed. The concise Verified cue retains the accessible completed-job meaning.

decisions.title: 1.8 history controls and public provenance
decisions.reason: Heading and filter use a clearer size hierarchy and stack at narrow widths with an intentional gap. Public Job # is quiet provenance text: the product job GET is Creator-owner only, and the prior demo dialog invented a public destination. No unsupported private navigation is advertised.

decisions.title: Discoverable compact pagination hover
decisions.reason: Shared compact+quiet recipe covers My Jobs and Reviews. Rest is transparent/borderless, targets do not shift, focus remains explicit, touch does not retain hover and reduced motion keeps static feedback.

parameters.name: Context and history
parameters.description: Desktop minmax(17rem,.8fr) / minmax(0,1.6fr); the left stack has a 1.25rem intrinsic gap. At max62rem context precedes history.

parameters.name: History rhythm
parameters.description: Heading1.125rem; body .95rem/1.65; date .8rem; rows1.5rem vertical rhythm; body measure68ch. Narrow card padding is min(1.25rem,4.5vw), preserving enlarged star and pager room.

parameters.name: Compact icon hover
parameters.description: Enabled compact quiet icons use a tonal circle and inset hairline on pointer hover. Quiet text controls remain transparent.

status.human: manual guidance received; revision awaits human review
status.color: Purple rejected. Replacement slate-blue/blue-teal palette awaiting human judgment
